focus.name: player-action-terrain-timer-continuation-static
focus.purpose: Bind the local continuation reached by the grounded terrain-timer action stream's interaction-flag branch and preserve its exact response behavior.

selection.condition: F2 tests flag target 0x870009 and branches to 0x00122910 when the interaction flag is set.

decoded: F4 compares TERRAIN_STOP_RIGHT_MOTION and TERRAIN_RIGHT_INNER_PROBE against zero, branching to 0x00122942
0x0AAE/0x0AB2 response frames publish PLAYER_ACTION_RESPONSE_STATE_A through ED writes to 0x00FFF0D8
F3 plays sound 0x21 and F5 uses ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84 at 0x001B7E40
EA terminators return through PLAYER_ANIM_LANDING_RESPONSE_SPAWN at 0x00122082

conclusion: The formerly generic 0x00122910-0x0012295D layout fragment is the producer-backed local continuation of the grounded terrain-timer action response, reached by the exact interaction-flag branch in PLAYER_ANIM_ACTION_TERRAIN_TIMER_GROUNDED.
